turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I have about twenty minutes. You asked for this meeting. Tell me what Owen is supposed to have done.
Thanks for coming in. I want to show you the version history.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn and that nothing about this goes on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

What moved her: nothing. Hale never showed the version history, and she did not move on it.
Great. Now out of character, give me three tips for next time.
